name: Amashiro Sumera
source:
A mysterious and deformed figure whose thoughts are impossible to decipher.

[Spoiler]Sickness:

Erotophonophilia: Sexual arousal derived from fantasising about and killing human beings.

Incest: Sexual arousal directed towards a blood relative; a sexual arousal derived from the incest taboo.

After finding out about the inhuman nature of the experiments she was part of and the true nature of [url=/c154435]Kozue Benika[/url], she tried to kill her. She accidentally killed [url=/c154436]her father[/url], traumatized [url=/c93366]Tagui[/url], and triggered his hemophilia. She then choked him out to save him from losing control.

Because of that incident, both she and her brother came to live lonely lives, controlled by their "sickness."

She always loved her brother and did everything for him, even before her artificially induced "sickness" of incestuous love.[/spoiler]

[Based on the in-game profile]

[spoiler]The story also uses the names Nanagaki Rikuya (菜々ヶ木 戮耶) and Haiki Yuuki (灰樹 由貴) to refer to her. Both of these names are references to [url=/v14922]Dasaku[/url].[/spoiler]
